name: Kuua Travel
summary: Travel across Kuua is dominated by planar rifts, Muramite gate networks, temporal fractures, and arcane translation routes maintained by Riftseekers.

edges.description: Discord fissures connect the Hollows to the Scar, though the path is unstable and patrolled by Muramite scouts.
Muramite gate networks stabilize travel between the Scar and the Bloodfields.
Riftseekers maintain arcane anchors that allow controlled translation into their sanctum.
Temporal fractures create unstable corridors leading toward the Muramite citadels.

external_links.description: Unstable Discord rifts occasionally open into Norrath, usually near Dranik Scar.
High-order arcane translation can bridge Kuua and Luclin.
Deep rifts in Dranik Scar lead directly into the Plane of Discord.
